Public saunas in Boston, MA

Boston's public sauna scene mixes old and new: Dillon's Russian Steam Bath in nearby Chelsea has operated since 1885, Kelo Spa & Steam in Newton Highlands runs a banya-style sauna built from Finnish kelo logs, and Moki runs Nordic-style social saunas with cold plunges in Allston and South Boston. Hours, men-only and women-only days, and seasonal changes vary, so confirm with each venue before you go.

4 venues, each checked against the venue's own website on 2026-11-04. Fields we could not confirm are marked Unknown. Prices and hours change, so confirm before you go.

Moki Sauna South Boston

South Boston · 385 Dorchester Ave, South Boston, MA
Wood-firedOutdoor
Drop-in price
$59 per person for a Social Session (shared sauna, includes access to all saunas and cold plunges during the session); 1-hour sessions also available (price Unknown)
Session length
Sessions typically last about 90 minutes plus changing time; 1-hour sessions also offered
Cold plunge
Indoor cedar barrel cold plunge, plus additional outdoor plunges in the courtyard (included)
Schedule / who
Mon-Thu 5pm-9pm, Fri 4pm-8pm, Sat 9am-1pm, Sun 8am-8pm per the venue's footer. Reservations recommended; walk-ins based on availability. Quiet Hours (silent sessions) run Wednesday evenings and Sunday mornings.
Notes
Three traditional Nordic saunas, an indoor cedar-barrel plunge and an outdoor courtyard with its own sauna and plunge. Towels and sandals provided; bring a bathing suit (robes can be rented). Complimentary lockers. Private rentals (Cozy Cabin, Treehouse, Outdoor Sauna) are sold separately. Which of the saunas are wood-fired is Unknown.

Dillon's Russian Steam Bath

Chelsea (just north of Boston) · 77 Chestnut Street, Chelsea, MA 02150
Russian banyaSteam roomBathhouse

Schedule / who
Mon 2pm-9pm (women only); Tue-Fri 11am-9pm (men only); Sat 11am-8pm (men only); Sun 7am-1pm (men only).
Notes
Traditional Russian-style steam bath in business since 1885, with a high-heat steam chamber (the venue says nearly 180 degrees on the upper benches), a wet steam room, showers, lounge and snack bar. Parking behind the building on Cherry Street. Separate men's and women's days only; there are no co-ed hours listed.
